other_conditions: Building must have a minimum constructed area of 50,000 sq.ft.
Investment must be made by infrastructure developers/industries.
Investment must be for leasing to IT/ITES industries or for own industrial use (computer systems, software/ITES, BPO, KPO).
Unit must provide at least 60% of its employment to people of the Union Territory of Puducherry and maintain this ratio during the period specified in the affidavit.
Industrial unit must not transfer or dispose of the fixed asset (including plant and machinery) for five years from the date of application or subsidy disbursement, whichever is later.
Additional investments made after the first claim are eligible for subsidy up to the ceiling limit.
Units that commenced commercial production on or after 1‑4‑2017 are considered new industries; those before are existing units.
If the same proprietor/partner/board establishes multiple units at different locations with separate licenses/clearances, each unit is eligible as a separate entity.
benefits_summary: Provides a 30% subsidy up to ₹1,00,00,000, disbursed in annual installments not exceeding ₹25,00,000 per annum.
documents_required: Copies of mandatory documents (including self‑attestation if required)
